title: vx cache clean --format json
description: With a bound (prune): what the policy evicted and the orphan sweep reaped. With no bound (clear): the directories it deleted. With dryRun, what they would.

evicted.description: index entries evicted by the age / size policy

bytesFreed.description: bytes those entries occupied, per the index

orphans.description: artifacts and temp files with no index row, reaped

cleared.description: the cache directory and the store deleted: workspace-relative inside it, else absolute
